# Community Rule Column 10 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 10 | **Condition:** complete

---

**10:1** With the coming of day and night I will enter the covenant of God, and with the going out of evening and morning I will speak His statutes;

**10:2** and while they exist I will set my boundary with no turning back. His judgment I acknowledge according to my perversity,

**10:3** and my transgressions are before my eyes as an engraved decree. To God I will say, "My Righteousness,"

**10:4** and to the Most High, "Foundation of my goodness, Source of knowledge and Spring of holiness,

**10:5** Height of glory, Almighty One of eternal majesty." I will choose what He teaches me, and I will be content with how He judges me.

**10:6** At the beginning of the dominion of light in its circuit, and at its gathering to its appointed dwelling;

**10:7** at the beginning of the watches of darkness, when He opens their storehouse and spreads them above,

**10:8** and in its circuit when they are gathered before the light; when the luminaries shine forth

**10:9** from the holy dwelling, when they are gathered to the place of glory.

**10:10** At the coming of the seasons according to the days of the month, together with their circuits

**10:11** from one to another; when they renew themselves — a great day for the Holy of Holies,

**10:12** and a sign for the opening of His eternal mercies; at the beginnings

**10:13** of the seasons in every time that shall be; at the beginning of months in their seasons,

**10:14** and holy days in their appointed order, as a memorial in their seasons.

**10:15** With an offering of the lips I will bless Him, according to a decree

**10:16** engraved forever; at the beginnings of years and in the circuit of their seasons,

**10:17** when the decree of their order is fulfilled, each day its regulation:

**10:18** harvest time to summer, sowing time to green growth,

**10:19** seasons of years to their weeks; and at the beginning of their weeks

**10:20** to a season of liberation. As long as I exist, an engraved decree

**10:21** is on my tongue as fruit of praise and the portion of my lips.

**10:22** I will sing with knowledge, and all my music shall be for the glory of God;

**10:23** my lyre and my harp for His holy decree, and the flute of my lips

**10:24** I will raise in His just measure. With the coming of day

**10:25** and night I will enter the covenant of God, and with the going out of

**10:26** evening and morning I will speak His statutes, and by them I will set my boundary.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 10 preserves the opening of the Hymn of the Instructor (maskil). The liturgical calendar structure governs the entire passage, with worship tied to astronomical and agricultural cycles. "Holy of Holies" (10:11) is a temporal designation marking a sacred moment in the calendrical cycle. The "season of liberation" (10:20) refers to the sabbatical/jubilee release. The repetition of the covenant-entry formula at the end (10:24-26) creates an inclusio with the column's opening.*
